title: Burglary
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree; 2nd degree if the actor purposely, knowingly or recklessly inflicts, attempts or threatens bodily injury, or is armed with explosives or a deadly weapon
key_points: Entering a research facility, structure or secured part of it, or surreptitiously remaining there, with purpose to commit an offense inside.
Trespassing in utility company property with purpose to commit an offense is included.
